_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, so a later edit to scene.narration can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

app-privacy.text: Every app page carries an App Privacy card, and where nobody has declared anything, it says so.

open.text: Companion Hub is the app runtime that lives in your house.

sign-in.text: It opens on a local login. Signing in anywhere else is optional.

pair-the-hub.text: A new Hub asks for one pairing code from Companion Portal.

first-boot.text: First boot is one pass. Local models, network, apps.

home-dashboard.text: This is home. Disk, CPU and memory, read off hardware you own.

browse-the-store.text: The store is fed by the open Hub market. Search, or browse.

open-alternatives.text: For the software you rent, the store names the open replacement you can own.

configure-install.text: Secrets generate themselves. Everything else an app asks for, you see before it runs.

install-and-run.text: When the badge turns green, the app is live on your own machine.

bring-your-own-app.text: Your own containers become a first class app, with a name and an address.

expose-a-port.text: Anything already running here gets a name, a certificate, and a door you choose.

local-models.text: The Hub reads your hardware and picks models it can actually run at home.

own-your-agents.text: Agents drive your Hub through tools you can read, scoped by keys you issue.

every-dial.text: Want the dials? They are all here. Reading your own logs costs nothing.

recap.text: Your hardware, your domain, your data. Nothing to cancel.

close.text: Companion Hub, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
